chunks: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Being affectionate toward the people is half the intellect.

key_terms.التَّوَدُّدُ: affection, endearment, showing warmth and love
key_terms.الْعَقْلِ: the intellect/reason — in Shia thought, 'aql is both a faculty of cognition and the foundation of moral-spiritual excellence

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about being affectionate toward people?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared that showing genuine warmth and affection toward people constitutes half of one's intellectual virtue. This teaching highlights that true 'aql (intellect/reason) in Islamic thought is not merely cognitive but deeply relational — wisdom is made manifest through how one treats fellow human beings. The early Muslim community would have understood this as a corrective to the notion that piety is purely inward, emphasizing that social conduct is a core dimension of rational and spiritual perfection.

en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
Being affectionate towards the people is half ‘الْعَقْلِ’ the intellect’.
en.sarwar: Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Showing that one loves people is half (the power) of reason.’”
